evals.prompt: Decorate the preview page for my private role. It has no decoration yet. Add a short intro and one hero image.
evals.expected_output: Reads the role and role_get_preview_page (status none), plans whitelisted blocks within the limits, picks a pass image from creator_image_list, saves with role_patch_preview_page using a fresh idempotencyKey, and polls moderation to a settled state.
expectations: The output reads role_get_preview_page and treats status none as a first decoration.
The output builds a whitelisted block document within the 200 KB / 200 blocks / 20000 character limits.
The output only uses images whose moderationState is pass from creator_image_list.
The output saves through role_patch_preview_page with schemaVersion and a fresh idempotencyKey and passes the read version.
The output waits for moderation and does not report a pending page as live.

evals.prompt: No suitable image exists, so generate one for this private role and put it on the preview page.
evals.expected_output: Generates via role_generate_assets, then polls creator_image_list until the intended URL reads pass before placing it, and treats a URL that was seen then disappeared as a terminal rejection.
expectations: The output generates the image, then polls creator_image_list until the intended URL shows moderationState pass before using it.
The output treats a URL that was seen and then disappeared from the list as a terminal rejection and stops polling it.
The output distinguishes a seen-then-vanished URL from a URL that has never appeared yet.
The output uses bounded polling with backoff and delivers without the image rather than waiting forever.
The output notes that a rejected generated image is charged and cannot be reused.

evals.prompt: I want to add a generated image to the preview page of a public role.
evals.expected_output: Explains that role_generate_assets returns public_role_requires_clone for a public role, does not retry generation, and falls back to an existing pass asset-library image or drops the image block while still decorating the text.
expectations: The output recognizes that generating for a public role returns public_role_requires_clone.
The output does not retry generation after public_role_requires_clone.
The output falls back to an existing pass image or drops the image block.
The output still completes the text decoration.
The output lists public_role_requires_clone as a terminal signal for the generation path.

evals.prompt: My save came back rejected, and an earlier save got a version conflict. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains that rejectReason is a category with no per-node path so the doc must be re-read and self-checked, that a version conflict means re-read the current version and reapply, and that each corrected save needs a fresh idempotencyKey.
expectations: The output treats rejectReason as a category-only signal with no per-node location.
The output re-reads and self-checks the document against the reject category before re-saving.
The output resolves a version conflict by re-reading the current version and reapplying the change.
The output uses a fresh idempotencyKey for the corrected save rather than replaying the old key.
The output handles a rate-limited save with backoff instead of a tight retry loop.
